purpose: Validate the repaired generic CLI contract inference against the highest-value discovered Code 128 barcode producer candidate.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
def load(name,path):
 p=pathlib.Path(path); s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); return m
probe=load('p','canonical/runtime/apt_cli_probe.py')
infer=load('i','canonical/runtime/cli_contract_inference.py')
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
pr=probe.probe('zint','2.13.0-1build3','cdd7a7379dae12c3effdb5f3d55c89077003b72772bcf543f7139146f272b769',root)
goal='Generate a Code 128 barcode image for the text PROJECT BRAIN and save it as canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PROJECT_BRAIN_BARCODE.png.'
ct=infer.infer_contract(pr,goal)
print(json.dumps(ct,sort_keys=True))
print('ZINT_CONTRACT_INFERRED')
PY
